title: Impact of light-polymerizing glaze on the surface, optical, mechanical, and biological properties of CAD-CAM denture base resins: A systematic review with meta-analysis
html: A light-polymerizing glaze has been proposed to improve the esthetic performance of computer-aided design and computer-aided manufacture (CAD-CAM) denture base resins; however, its effects on surface, optical, mechanical, and biological properties remain unclear.
